_comment: Per-record verification decisions for the 22 records that were not current-verified at the start of the final audit. Every decision names the official page it was taken from and quotes it. A record is only VERIFIED when the live official source supports the stored record; a fetch failure is never evidence.

deadline_clearances._comment: Records outside the 22 whose stored deadline value is provably not an application deadline. Each quotes the stored text verbatim and clears it. No replacement date is supplied: a correct date is a separate finding that has to arrive with its own evidence, and inventing one would replace a false claim with a false claim.

records.reason: The stored deadline_display is the single word 'is', the tail of a sentence split during extraction. Its stored application_period is the payment section of the same official page ('The application fee must be paid in full either by card or via bank transfer . No cash payments are possible. You will find the payment instructions at the end of your online application form.'), which is an instruction and not a date. Only the display is removed; the stored deadline_date 2027-02-28 is left alone because this audit did not re-read the Czech page and has no evidence either way about that date.
The stored deadline_display is the tail of an acceptance condition ('...for accepting their study place'), which is an obligation on an admitted student, not an application deadline.

records.stored_deadline_display: for the discounted payment will be stated in your tuition fee payment information given upon admission.
records.reason: The stored deadline_display describes when a discounted tuition payment is quoted to an admitted student, not when to apply. Its stored application_period is a document-upload instruction ('If you are exempted from tuition fees on the grounds of your residence permit, upload copies of both the front and back sides of your residence permit card to your application form.'). The stored precision 'application_dead' is also not a value the shared deadline semantics defines, so clearing it resolves the record to 'unknown'.

The award name survives only in a cross-reference: 'International students applying for studentships must also apply for an Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship or be able to demonstrate the availability of funds to meet the full overseas tuition fee.' That cross-reference does not support any of the stored specifics - the tuition-fee-gap amount of about GBP 16,000-20,000 a year, about 30 awards a year, 'All overseas nationalities (non-UK)', or an 'Early February 2026' deadline - and discontinuation is equally not proven.
